title: Can We Change the Stroke Size for Easier Diffusion?
abstract: arXiv:2603.26783v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models can be challenged in the low signal-to-noise regime, where they have to make pixel-level predictions despite the presence of high noise. The geometric intuition is akin to using the finest stroke for oil painting throughout, which may be ineffective. We therefore study \emph{stroke-size control} as a controlled intervention that changes the roughness of the supervised target, predictions and perturbations across timesteps, in an attempt to ease the low signal-to-noise challenge via prediction target simplification.

translated_title: 我们能否通过改变笔画大小来简化扩散过程？
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在低信噪比区间可能面临挑战，此时它们必须在存在高噪声的情况下进行像素级预测。其几何直觉类似于在整个油画过程中始终使用最细的笔画，这可能效果不佳。因此，我们研究了“笔画大小控制”作为一种受控干预手段，它在不同时间步上改变监督目标、预测和扰动的粗糙度，试图通过简化预测目标来缓解低信噪比带来的挑战。
tldr: 该论文提出“笔画大小控制”方法，通过在不同时间步调整监督目标、预测和扰动的粗糙度来简化预测目标，从而缓解扩散模型在低信噪比情况下的预测挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "stroke-size control," a controlled intervention that adjusts the roughness of supervised targets, predictions, and perturbations across timesteps to simplify prediction targets and ease the low signal-to-noise challenge in diffusion models.
